title: Levantine Arabic Sign Language
displaytitle: Levantine Arabic Sign Language

titles.display: Levantine Arabic Sign Language

extract: Levantine Arabic Sign Language is the sign language used by people of the area known as Bilad al-Sham or the Levant, comprising Jordan, Palestine, Syria, and Lebanon. Although there are significant differences in vocabulary between the four states, this is not much greater than regional differences within the states. Grammar is quite uniform and mutual intelligibility is high, indicating that they are dialects of a single language.
